blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD
blocks.zh: 文件理解系统通常通过布局分析、光学文本识别、读序预测和图像字幕作为单独的组件加以评价。 这种分离使得科学人物,标题和视觉语义连接薄弱,无法衡量一个模型是否能够产生一个既在结构上忠实又能精准获取的单页级剖析. 我们引入 Read-Parse-Description,一个用于文档解析的用视觉元素描述生成的统一数据集. 鉴于一个页面图像,模型需要输出一个有序的布局元素列表,包含边框,语义标签,读序索引,公认的文本内容,以及视觉元素的替代文本描述. 该基准以2 402份文件为基础,包括18 163个连续页、125 218个布局要素和11 338个视觉实例。 此外,我们进一步提出一个插座和游戏空间意识增强器,重新利用多层视觉特征,并将网格感知空间引导注入视觉语言符号,用于布局感知生成. 跨端到端的VLM和管道解析器的实验显示,现有的系统仍然在努力联合恢复读取顺序和视觉语义,而我们增强的模型则实现了强大的联合性能. 这些结果突出表明,需要超越孤立的文档解析模块,转向联合阅读、解析和描述复杂文档的统一模式。 新的数据集和代码将在https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD上公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scientific documents are not just sequences of recognized words. A single page may contain two-column prose, section headers, equations, tables, figures, captions, footnotes, author metadata, and visual evidence whose meaning is not recoverable from optical character recognition (OCR) alone. Document AI has therefore progressed through layout analysis Xu et al. (2020) ; Xu et al. (2021) ; Huang et al. (2022) ; Chen et al. (2024) , table recognition Zhong et al. (2020) , document VQA Kim et al. (2022) , OCR-free parsing Wei et al. (2024) ; Wei et al. (2025) , and multimodal document models Ye et al. (2023) . In accessibility and machine-readable paper ingestion, the useful output is not an isolated layout map or a free-form page summary, but a structured page representation that can be read, reflowed, indexed, and audited.
blocks.zh: 科学文件不仅仅是识别词的序列. 单页可能包含两栏取词,分节标题,等式,表格,数字,标题,脚注,作者元数据,以及其含义不能仅从光学字符识别(OCR)中取回的视觉证据. 因此,文件AI通过布局分析取得了进展。 Huang等人(2022年);Chen等人(2024年);表认钟等(2020年);VQA Kim等(2022年);OCR自由剖析Wei等(2024年);Wei等(2025年);多模式文件模型 Ye等 (2023) (英语). 在可访问性和机器可读取的纸张中,有用的输出不是孤立的布局图或自由格式的页面摘要,而是结构化的可被读取,再流取,索引化,审核的页面表现.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks usually evaluate pieces of this representation in isolation. Layout datasets measure region localization Zhong et al. (2019) ; Li et al. (2020) ; Pfitzmann et al. (2022) , OCR and table benchmarks Smock et al. (2022) measure textual structure, reading-order datasets Wang et al. (2021b) focus on sequencing, captioning, and alt-text datasets Sharma et al. (2018) ; Srivatsan et al. (2024) describe isolated or context-conditioned images. These tasks are necessary, but they do not test whether a system can produce a single consistent parse in which boxes, labels, reading order, text, tables, captions, and visual descriptions agree with each other. This gap is particularly visible in scientific PDFs, where captions frequently refer to nearby figures or tables, equations interrupt prose, and visual elements carry technical information that should be exposed to downstream readers.
blocks.zh: 现有基准通常孤立地评估这种代表性。 布局数据集衡量区域局部化 钟等 (2019年); 李等 (2020年); Pfitzmann等 (2022年); OCR和表基准 Smock等 (2022年) 测量文本结构,读取顺序数据集 Wang等 (2021b) 专注于排序,标题,和alt-text数据集 Sharma等 (2018); Srivatsan等 (2024) 描述孤立或有上下文条件的图像. 这些任务是必要的,但它们并不测试一个系统是否能够产生一个单一的一致解析,其中的框,标签,读取顺序,文本,表格,标题和可视描述相互一致. 这种差距在科学PDF中特别明显,其中的字幕经常指相邻的数字或表格,等式会打断道词,而视觉元素携带的技术信息应当被下游的读者所暴露.

blocks.en: We introduce Read-Parse-Describe , a unified task and dataset for unified document parsing with visual element description generation as shown in Fig. 1 . Given a page image, a model must output an ordered list of elements, which includes a bounding box, semantic category, reading-order index, recognized text content, an explicit caption link when applicable, and an alternative-text description for visual elements. The key novelty is not any single field, but enforcing their agreement in one auditable page parse. The unified output contract can be implemented by either end-to-end models or modular systems. The benchmark contains 2,402 open-access scientific documents, 18,164 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances.
blocks.zh: 我们引入 Read-Parse-Description(Read-Parse-Description),这是一个用于用视觉元素描述生成来解析统一文档的统一任务和数据集,见图1。 鉴于一个页面图像,一个模型必须输出一个命令的元素列表,其中包含一个边框,语义类,读取顺序索引,被认可的文本内容,在适用时有明确的标题链接,以及视觉元素的替代文本描述. 关键的新奇之处并不是任何单一领域,而是在一个可审计的页面中执行它们的协议。 统一产出合同可以通过端到端模型或模块化系统执行. 基准包括2 402个开放存取科学文件、18 164个连续页、125 218个布局要素和11 338个视觉实例。

blocks.en: Modern VLMs and document-specialized models Dosovitskiy et al. (2021) ; Li et al. (2023) ; Dai et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2023b) ; Bai et al. (2023) ; Lv et al. (2023) ; Bai et al. (2025) ; Gemma Team et al. (2025) increasingly use frozen or partially frozen visual encoders. When such models merge visual tokens before generation, local spatial evidence can be weakened exactly where element extents, reading order, and caption-object alignment are required. We therefore introduce SARA , a lightweight Spatial Alignment Residual Adapter for end-to-end VLM parsing. SARA freezes the base VLM, reuses intermediate visual encoder layers, projects their concatenated features into the token space, aligns with crop-aware spatial grids, and injects into the native merged tokens. The task makes spatial-alignment failures measurable, while SARA tests a direct architectural response without changing labels or evaluation. To summarize, our contributions are as follows: • We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a novel task and dataset for unified document parsing with alternative-text generation into a shared structured schema. • We propose SARA, a Spatial Alignment Residual Adapter that injects crop-aware spatial cues into VLM tokens to improve layout-sensitive document understanding. • We establish a unified evaluation protocol covering both document parsing and alternative-text generation, enabling systematic assessment of parsing fidelity and generation quality. • We conduct extensive experiments and ablation studies, showing that crop-aware spatial alignment consistently benefits unified document parsing and alternative-text generation.
blocks.zh: 现代VLMs和文档专用模型 Dosovitskiy等 (2021);Li等 (2023); Dai等 (2023);Liu等 (2023b); Bai等人(2023年);Lv等人(2023年); Bai等人(2025);Gemma Team等 (2025)越来越多地使用被冻结或部分被冻结的视觉编码器. 当这种模型在生成前合并了可视符号时,局部空间证据可以被削弱,具体位置是需要元素范围,读取顺序,以及标题-对象对齐. 因此,我们引入了SARA,一个轻量级空间对齐残余适应器,用于从端到端的VLM解析. SARA冻结了基础VLM,再用中间视觉编码器层,将其相接的特征投放到信使空间,与作物感知空间网格相配合,并注入了原生的并用信使. 任务使得空间对接故障可以衡量,而SARA则在不改变标签或评价的情况下测试一种直接的建筑反应. 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们介绍Read-Parse-Description,这是用于统一文档的新任务和数据集,将替代文本生成解析成一个共同的结构化计划。 我们提议使用SARA这一空间对齐残余适应器,将作物感知空间提示注入VLM符号,以增进对布局敏感文件的理解。 我们制定了统一的评估协议,涵盖文件解析和替代文本生成,从而能够系统地评估解析忠诚度和生成质量。 我们进行了广泛的实验和减肥研究,表明作物感知的空间调整始终有利于统一的文件解析和替代文本生成。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Document Layout and Parsing Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 文档布局和解析数据集

blocks.en: Document-layout benchmarks have made document understanding measurable by isolating the output. Early resources, such as RVL-CDIP Harley et al. (2015) , treat documents as classes, whereas FUNSD Jaume et al. (2019) focuses on form. CORD Park et al. (2019) and SROIE Huang et al. (2021) further show that domain-specific schemas enhance extraction but specialized. Similar to table, SciTSR Chi et al. (2019) targets scientific table structure, and PubTables-1M Smock et al. (2022) scales table recognition, but neither requires the table, caption, reading position, and visual description to agree in one element record. PubLayNet Zhong et al. (2019) made large-scale layout detection practical, and DocBank Li et al. (2020) expand token-level layout supervision. DocLayNet Pfitzmann et al. (2022) improved further with richer human annotations, while M6Doc Cheng et al. (2023) expanded layout analysis across heterogeneous documents. For robustness, RoDLA Chen et al. (2024) stresses layout robustness, whereas ReadingBank Wang et al. (2021b) isolates reading-order prediction. Broader evaluations such as DocVQA Mathew et al. (2021) and DUDE Van Landeghem et al. (2023) test document understanding through answers rather than page parses. OmniDocBench Ouyang et al. (2025) moves closer to document parsing, while MMLongBench-Doc Ma et al. (2024) stresses long-context document understanding.
blocks.zh: 文件分发基准通过将产出隔离,使文件的理解可以衡量。 早期的资源,如RVL-CDIP Harley等(2015年),将文档作为类,而FUNSD Jaume等(2019年)则以形式为主. CORD( 哥伦布省) Park等 (2019)和SROIE Huang等. (2021)进一步显示,针对特定域的策略可以增强取出但具有特异性. 与表类似,SciTSR Chi等(2019年)的目标是科学表结构,而Pubtables-1M Smock等(2022年)尺度表识别,但都没有要求表,标题,读取位置,和视觉描述在一个元素记录中达成一致. PubLayNet Zhong等 (2019)使大规模布局探测实用,多克班克·李等. (2020年) 拓展信使级布局监管. DocLayNet Pfitzmann等人(2022年)随着更丰富的人文说明而进一步改善,而M6Doc Cheng等人(2023年)则将布局分析扩展到了各种文件。 为了稳健,RODLA 陈等. (2024)强调布局稳健性,而ReadingBank Wang等 (2021b)则隔离了读取顺序预测. DocVQA Mathew等人(2021年)和DUDE Van Landeghem等人(2023年)等更广泛的评价通过答案而不是页剖面来理解测试文件。 奥姆尼道克奔驰 Ouyang等 (2025) 更接近文件解析,而MMLong Bench-Doc Ma等. (2024)强调长文本文档理解.

blocks.en: 2.2 Document VLMs and Pipeline Systems
blocks.zh: 2.2 文件VLM和管道系统

blocks.en: Structure-aware representations are often precise, while generative systems are flexible but low performance. LayoutLM Xu et al. (2020) and LayoutLMv2 Xu et al. (2021) made layout-aware pretraining central for document understanding. LayoutLMv3 Huang et al. (2022) further unifies text and image modeling through task-specific heads rather than complete generator. DocFormer Appalaraju et al. (2021) and VGT Da et al. (2023) emphasize structure-aware encoding, reinforcing the explicit geometry. OCR-free generation such as Donut Kim et al. (2022) can emit structured text directly from an image, while Pix2Struct Lee et al. (2023) support screenshot-style pretraining. Nougat Blecher et al. (2023) specializes this generative view for academic documents, and GOT-OCR Wei et al. (2024) extends OCR-style generation toward broader text recognition. Recent document parsers push toward full-page extraction, e.g . , DeepSeek-OCR Wei et al. (2025) uses visual compression for OCR, while Dolphin-v2 Feng et al. (2026) illustrates universal document parsing. MonkeyOCR Li et al. (2025) emphasizes structure-recognition-relation decomposition, and PaddleOCR-VL Cui et al. (2025a) targets compact multilingual document parsing. MinerU Wang et al. (2024) takes a more inspectable pipeline route. General VLMs provide another axis of flexibility, e.g . , BLIP-2 Li et al. (2023) and InstructBLIP Dai et al. (2023) align visual features with language models, while LLaVA Liu et al. (2023b) and Qwen2.5-VL Bai et al. (2025) show strong instruction-following multimodal generation. Agentic parsing is also studied in ParseFixer Yu et al. (2026) , which applies selective correction to backbone Markdown outputs, and ParseBench Zhang et al. (2026) , which evaluates agent-relevant parsing capabilities on enterprise documents.
blocks.zh: 结构意识的表达方式往往精确,而基因系统灵活而性能低. 布局LM 徐等 (2020年)和布局LMv2 徐等. (2021)将布局意识预训作为文档理解的核心. 布局LMv3 Huang等 (2022)通过任务特定头来进一步统一文本和图像模型,而不是完整的生成器. DocFormer Appalaraju等 (2021)和VGT Da等. (2023)强调结构意识编码,强化了显相几何. Donut Kim等人(2022年)等没有OCR的生成可以直接从图像中释放出结构化的文本,而Pix2Struct Lee等. (2023)支持截图式预训. Nougat Blecher等人(2023年)专门将这种遗传学观点用于学术文献,而GOT-OCR Wei等人. (2024)将OCR风格的生成扩展至更广泛的文本识别. 最近文档解析器向全页取出推进,例如,DeepSeek-OCR Wei等人(2025年)对OCR使用视觉压缩,而Dolphin-v2 Feng等人(2026年)则说明了通用文档解析. 猴猫 Li等 (2025)强调结构-识别-关系分解,而PaddleOCR-VL Cui等. (2025a) 瞄准紧凑多语种文件解析. 矿山 王等 (2024年)取出更可检查的管道路线. General VLMs提供了另一种灵活性轴,例如:BLIP-2 Li等 (2023)和InstructBLIP Dai等. 2023年(2023年)将视觉特征与语言模型相配合,而LLaVA Liu等(2023年b)和Quen2.5-VL Bai等(2025年)则表现出强烈的跟随多模式生成. 在ParseFixer Yu等人(2026年)和Parse Bench Zhang等人(2026年)中也研究了代理解析,后者对主干Markdown输出进行了选择性的校正,后者评价了企业文件中与代理解析能力有关.

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual Descriptions and Accessibility
blocks.zh: 2.3 视觉描述和无障碍

blocks.en: Accessibility work shows why visual description cannot be reduced to generic captioning. Conceptual Captions Sharma et al. (2018) demonstrates the scale available in web alt text, but weakly tied to accessibility intent. VizWiz Gurari et al. (2018) and VizWiz-Captions Gurari et al. (2020) foreground blind-user scenarios, where the useful answer depends on context. TextCaps Sidorov et al. (2020) shows that descriptions may depend on visible text, and OCR-VQA Mishra et al. (2019) makes text reading part of visual question answering. Screen2Words Wang et al. (2021a) shifts the target to UI screens, while Alt-Text with Context Srivatsan et al. (2024) conditions descriptions on surrounding social text. Furthermore, ChartQA Masry et al. (2022) requires visual and logical reasoning, and DePlot Liu et al. (2023a) recovers chart data before reasoning. Chart-to-Text Kantharaj et al. (2022) directly studies chart description, while PlotQA Methani et al. (2020) emphasizes quantitative plot understanding. A useful description must be tied to the correct object, caption, page position, and surrounding reading flow. Read-Parse-Describe therefore evaluates alternative text as a field in the parse rather than as an isolated captioning output.
blocks.zh: 无障碍工作表明,为什么视觉描述不能被降为通用标题。 Captions Sharma等人(2018年)展示了网页替代文本中可用的规模,但与无障碍意图联系不大。 VizWiz Gurari等 (2018)和VizWiz-Captions Gurari等 (2020) 前景盲-用户假想,有用的答案取决于上下文. TextCaps Sidorov等 (2020年)显示描述可能依赖于可见文本,而OCR-VQA Mishra等 (2019年)则将文本读取作为视觉问答的一部分. 屏幕2字 Wang等 (2021a)将目标转移到UI屏幕上,而Alt-Text与Context Srivatsan等 (2024)则对周围的社会文本进行条件描述. 此外,图QA Masry等 (2022) 需要视觉和逻辑推理,而DePlot Liu等. (2023a)在推理前恢复图表数据. Chart-to-Text Kantharaj等人(2022年)直接研究了图表描述,而PlotQA Methani等人则研究了图描述. (2020)强调量化的地块理解. 一个有用的描述必须绑定在正确的对象,标题,页面位置,以及周围的读取流上. 因此,Read-Parse-Description将替代文本评价为剖析中的一个字段,而不是孤立的标题输出.

blocks.en: 3 Read-Parse-Describe Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 读取- 辅助- 描述数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en: We introduce the Read-Parsing-Describe, a dataset for document parsing with grounded visual description. This task is motivated by two limitations of existing document understanding benchmarks as shown in Tab. 1 . First, many layout datasets primarily focus on the physical localization of page regions but do not require models to recover a complete logic-aware document representation. This limitation is especially pronounced in scientific papers, where frequently break simple top-to-bottom ordering rules. Second, visual elements are often treated as layout categories rather than semantic objects. Figures, charts, diagrams, screenshots may be localized, but the information they convey is rarely required to be presented in a grounded, accessible form.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Read-Parsing-Description,一个用有底的可视描述分析文档的数据集。 这项任务的动机是Tab所示的现有文件理解基准有两个局限性。 1,第一,许多布局数据集主要注重页面区域的实际本地化,但不需要模型来恢复一个完整的有逻辑意识的文档表达. 这种限制在科学论文中尤其明显,经常打破简单的上下排序规则. 其次,视觉元素常常被作为布局类,而不是语义对象来对待. 数字、图表、图和截图可能是局部的,但它们所传递的信息很少需要以可以查阅的形式提供。

Structured Output denotes a single page-level prediction that jointly contains layout, order, textual content, and caption links.
blocks.zh: 表1:数据集目标合同比较。 检查标记表明,基准明确要求相应的字段作为其评价目标的一部分。 说明链接(Caption Links)是指视觉对象与其标题之间的明确关联. 结构化输出表示一个单一的页面级别预测,它共同包含布局,顺序,文字内容和标题链接.

blocks.en: 3.2 Output Schema
blocks.zh: 3.2 输出Schema

blocks.en: Read-Parsing-Describe therefore evaluates document understanding as a unified multi-modal parsing problem. The target output is an ordered list of document elements. Each element contains its bounding box, semantic category, reading-order index, recognized content when applicable, caption linkage, and visual description when applicable: Y = [ e 1 , e 2 , … , e n ] , Y=[e_{1},e_{2},\ldots,e_{n}], (1) where each element is represented as e i = { id , bbox , category , order , text , html , caption_id , alt_text } , e_{i}=\{\texttt{id},\texttt{bbox},\texttt{category},\texttt{order},\texttt{text},\texttt{html},\texttt{caption\_id},\texttt{alt\_text}\}, (2) where id is the element identifier, bbox is a page-coordinate box [ x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ] [x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}] in the rendered image coordinate system. category is the semantic layout label, and order is the canonical human reading-order index. blocks.en: An ordered schema is the full element list Y Y after sorting by the reading-order index. The central design choice is to make fields agree inside the same element object, not to score familiar subtasks in isolation. The contract has four coupled decisions: Coupling Design reason Failure exposed Element identity Bind id , category , textual content, caption links, and descriptions to the same object. Free-floating OCR, HTML, captions, or descriptions cannot be credited without the element they claim to describe. Geometry as evidence Treat bbox as the audit handle for text, tables, and visual descriptions. A plausible description or table string attached to the wrong crop becomes measurable rather than silently accepted. Canonical reading flow Use order as human reading order rather than visual-nearest-neighbor order. Two-column text, spanning figures, and separated captions expose sequence errors even when OCR is correct. Caption semantics Require caption_id and alt_text for visual instances when applicable. A model must bind the object, caption, and description instead of generating generic image captions.

Region proposals decide the visual evidence available to OCR, table serialization, caption linkage, and alt-text generation. Reading-order decisions decide where captions and objects sit in the page narrative; and visual descriptions are auditable only when their evidence is localized.

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Creation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集创建管道

blocks.en: We collect open-access PDF papers from the ACM Digital Library and retain document metadata. Since the main contributions, core figures, methods, and experimental results of scientific papers are usually concentrated in the main body, we extract the first eight pages of each paper and keep shorter papers in their entirety. This page-level curation strategy preserves structurally and semantically informative regions of papers while reducing the dominance of long reference sections and appendices. To focus annotation on the dense parts of papers while reducing long reference sections, we retain the first eight pages of each paper and keep shorter papers in full. Additional detailed dataset statistics would be included in the technical appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们从ACM数字图书馆收集开放式PDF文件,并保留文件元数据。 由于科学论文的主要贡献,核心人物,方法,实验成果通常集中在正文中,所以我们提取出每篇论文的前八页并完整地保存较短的论文. 这一页面级的校准战略保留了结构上和内容翔实的论文区域,同时减少了长篇参考章节和附录的主导地位. 为了集中对文件的密集部分进行注释,同时减少较长的参考部分,我们保留了每份文件的前八页并保留了较短的论文全文。 技术附录将载列其他详细数据集统计数据。

blocks.en: The visual elements include tables, diagrams, screenshots, photographs, charts, and long-tail illustrations. This diversity matters because visual-description generation is not the same problem for each object type, e.g . , a UI screenshot requires interface semantics. The layout labels are similarly heterogeneous, covering structural headers, scholarly objects, captions, references, lists, and paragraphs. We keep these categories explicit to avoid hiding errors that make scientific PDFs hard to parse. We split at the paper level with a 90:5:5 train/validation/test ratio after deduplication. Exact duplicate PDFs are removed using SHA-256 hashes, DOI metadata is used when available, normalized titles are matched otherwise, and near-duplicate title/abstract pairs above the similarity threshold are manually inspected. Paper-level splitting is important because adjacent pages share templates, section styles, figure numbering, author metadata, and sometimes repeated visual objects. Contrast a page-level split would overstate generalization for reading order and caption linkage.
blocks.zh: 视觉元素包括表格,图表,截图,相片,图表,和长尾插图. 这种多样性之所以重要,是因为视觉描述生成对于每个对象类型来说并不是相同的问题,例如,一个UI截图需要接口语义. 版式标签也相似,包括结构标题、学术对象、标题、参考资料、清单和段落。 我们保留这些分类,以避免隐藏错误,使科学的PDF难以解析. 我们在纸面上以90:5:5的列车/验证/测试分出分出分出分出. 精确重复的PDF使用SHA-256散列取出,可用时使用DOI元数据取出,普通标题另作匹配,类似阈值以上的近重复标题/抽象对等进行人工检查. 纸层分拆很重要,因为相邻的页面共享模板,段落样式,数字编号,作者元数据,有时还会重复视觉对象. 对比一个分页的分页会超标一般化读取顺序和标题链接 。

blocks.en: 3.4 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.4注解管道

blocks.en: Annotations are produced with a bootstrap-and-correct pipeline designed around cross-field consistency. A document parser first initializes layout boxes and labels. The generated boxes, semantic categories, caption links, and reading-order indices are then manually inspected and corrected together, rather than as independent layers. Corrections target common scientific-PDF failure modes: two-column reading order, spanning figures, captions separated from visual objects, footnotes, equations, author metadata, and fine-grained heading levels. This joint correction step is important: moving a box can change its text crop, its caption candidate, and its reading-order position.
blocks.zh: 说明书是用一个以跨战地一致性为中心设计的有靴子和正确管线编写的。 一个文档解析器首先初始化了布局框和标签. 生成的框,语义分类,标题链接,以及读取顺序索引,然后进行手动检查和校正,而不是作为独立的地层. 校正目标常见的科学-PDF故障模式:双列读取顺序,横跨数字,从视觉对象中分离来的标题,脚注,等式,作者元数据,以及细纹标题等. 这个联合校正步骤很重要:移动一个框可以改变它的文本收成,标题候选,以及它的读取顺序位置.

blocks.en: The alt-text process is designed for benchmark consistency, not as an automatic accessibility deployment pipeline. The prompt asks for concise factual descriptions and discourages speculation beyond visible evidence. The scoring step checks whether the description is faithful, complete enough for the object type, and aligned with the prompt; human refinement is concentrated on low-score cases because these are most likely to contain missing relationships, hallucinated labels, or vague descriptions. We expose this procedure because visual-description labels are harder to audit than boxes or OCR strings, and the reader should be able to separate measured model behavior from annotation assumptions.
blocks.zh: 备选文字程序是为了基准一致性而设计的,而不是作为自动无障碍部署管道。 立即要求简明的事实描述,并阻止超出明显证据的猜测。 分分步骤检查描述是否忠实,是否足够完整,适合对象类型,并与快取一致;人类的精细化集中于低分数案例,因为这些案例最有可能包含缺失的关系,幻觉标签,或模糊的描述. 我们揭露这个程序是因为视觉描述标签比盒或OCR字符串更难审计,读者应该能够将测量的模型行为与注释假设区分开来.

blocks.en: 4 SARA: Spatial Alignment Residual Adapter
blocks.zh: 4 SARA:空间对接残余适应器

blocks.en: Read-Parse-Describe turns parsing into a binding problem, i.e . , each generated element must keep the attribute attached to the same page evidence. This creates a different pressure from ordinary VLM generation. A visual concatenation is useful due to the compression of image tokens into a sequence the decoder can consume, but that compression can blur the local spatial cues needed to decide where an element starts, how two-column regions should be ordered, and which caption belongs to which object. The design goal of SARA is therefore not to replace the base VLM, but to restore crop-level spatial evidence at the point where the decoder receives merged visual tokens. The key design choice is to preserve correspondence between each crop’s pre-merger grid and its native post-merger tokens, enabling aligned feature re-injection without ground-truth input boxes.
blocks.zh: Read-Parse-Description将解析变成具有约束力的问题,即每个生成的元素必须保持属性附于同页证据. 这造成了不同于普通VLM生成的压力. 由于将图像符压缩成解码器能消耗的序列,视觉凝聚是有用的,但压缩可以模糊决定元素从何处起步,如何命令双柱区域,以及哪个标题属于哪个对象所需的局部空间提示. 因此,SARA的设计目标不是要取而代之地基VLM,而是在解码器接收被合并的可视化符时恢复作物级空间证据. 关键的设计选择是保留每个作物合并前的网格与其原生的合并后活字符号之间的对应关系,从而能够在没有地-地-地-地-地输入框的情况下重新注入一致的特性。

Features from encoder layers are concatenated, followed by a grid-aware multi-crop alignment mechanism that preserves spatial structure. The aligned features serve as spatial guidance and are injected into the original tokens via a gated residual connection.

blocks.en:
SARA follow threefold design as shown in the Fig. 1 :
(1) Reuse intermediate visual states rather than only the final merged tokens, because earlier layers retain finer layout and boundary information.
(2) Align the reused states to the same crop grid as the native visual merger, so the residual signal has the same token-level support as the decoder’s original visual stream.
(3) Inject the aligned guidance through a learnable residual gate, preserving the pretrained visual-language pathway while letting training decide how much spatial correction is useful.

blocks.en: 6.1 Settings and Metrics
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置和计量

blocks.en: We evaluate three categories of systems: general-purpose VLMs, specialized document models, and pipeline parsers. General-purpose VLMs include Qwen3.5 Qwen Team (2026) , Gemma4 Google DeepMind (2026c) , ChatGPT-5.4 OpenAI (2026b) , ChatGPT-5.6 OpenAI (2026a) , Gemini 3.6 Flash Google DeepMind (2026b) and Gemini 3.1 Pro Google DeepMind (2026a) . Specialized document models include DeepSeek-OCR Wei et al. (2025) , DeepSeek-OCR2 Wei et al. (2026) , Dolphin-v2 Feng et al. (2026) , MonkeyOCR Li et al. (2025) , VGT Da et al. (2023) , GOT-OCR 2.0 Wei et al. (2024) , Nougat Blecher et al. (2023) , and PaddleOCR-VL Cui et al. (2025a) . Pipeline parsers include PP-StructureV3 Cui et al. (2025b) and MinerU Wang et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价三类系统:通用甚高频、专用文件模型和管道剖析器。 通用VLM包括Quen3.5 Quen Team (2026),Gemma4 Google DeepMind (2026c),ChatGPT-5.4 OpenAI (2026b),ChatGPT-5.6 OpenAI (2026a),双子座 3.6 Flash Google DeepMind (2026b)和双子座 3.1 Pro Google DeepMind (2026a). 专门的文档模型包括DeepSeek-OCR Wei等 (2025),DeepSeek-OCR2 Wei等人(2026年),多芬-v2 Feng等人(2026年),MonkeyOCR Li等 (2025年),VGT Da等 (2023年),GOT-OCR 2.0 Wei等 (2024年),Nougat Blecher等 (2023年),和PaddleOCR-VL Cui等 (2025年a). 管道分解器包括PP-StructureV3 Cui等 (2025b)和MinerU Wang等 (2024).

blocks.en: All systems are evaluated under the same page-level output schema. Zero-shot systems use released checkpoints or official APIs without in-context examples. Full fine-tuning baselines serialize each target element list into text and optimize the standard autoregressive next-token objective on the training split. The validation split is used for model selection, and final results are reported on the held-out test split. For SARA runs, the base VLM is frozen and only the adapter pathway is trained. For generative VLMs, we use deterministic decoding whenever supported. Outputs from pipeline systems are converted into the unified schema.
blocks.zh: 所有系统都在同一页级产出计划下进行评估。 零镜头系统使用已放行的检查站或官方API,没有内文实例. 全面微调基线将每个目标元素列表序列化为文本并优化培训分拆上的标准自旋下接目标. 验证分拆用于模型选择,最后结果报告于搁置测试分拆. 对于 SARA 运行,基 VLM 被冻结,并且只有适配器路径被训练. 对于基因的VLM,只要得到支持,我们就会使用决定性的解码. 管道系统的产出被转换成统一的计划。

blocks.en: All metrics are computed after schema conversion. Minor syntax errors are repaired deterministically; if a prediction remains unparsable, the affected fields are treated as empty. F1 follows the IoU-matching convention used by PubLayNet Zhong et al. (2019) , DocLayNet Pfitzmann et al. (2022) , and RoDLA Chen et al. (2024) : a match requires the same category label and IoU ≥ 0.5 \operatorname{IoU}\geq 0.5 . mIoU is computed over matched true positives. Reading-order (RO) score uses normalized edit-distance similarity over matched element identifiers Wang et al. (2021b) . OCR accuracy is computed as normalized character-level edit-distance similarity after text normalization. For visual descriptions, we report METEOR Banerjee and Lavie (2005) and BERTScore Zhang et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 所有衡量标准都是在计划转换后计算的。 小的语法错误被确定修复;如果一个预测仍然无法解析,那么受影响的字段被视作空. F1遵循了由PubLayNet Zhong等人(2019年)、DocLayNet Pfitzmann等人(2022年)和RoDLA使用的IoU比对公约。 Chen 等 (2024): 匹配需要相同的类别标签和 IoU → 0.5\操作名{ IoU → geq 0.5 mIoU的计算结果与真实的正数相符。 读取顺序(RO)分数使用正则编辑-距离相近于匹配元素标识符 王等 (2021b) (中文(简体) ). OCR精度在文本正常化后作为常态字符级编辑相近性来计算. 关于视觉描述,我们报告METEOR Banerjee和Lavie(2005年)以及BERTScore Zhang等人(2020年)。

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要结果

blocks.en: Table 2 should be read as a contract diagnostic, not a leaderboard. The unified schema requires models to jointly recover localized elements, reading order, textual content, and visual descriptions. Pipeline parsers often retain strong OCR or localization performance, but they usually leave caption links and alt-text fields incomplete. General-purpose VLMs can produce richer schema fields, but they are less reliable in spatial grounding without adaptation. Document-specialized VLMs and SARA are complementary: the former excel at specialized parsing, while SARA improves the structural fields of a frozen general-purpose VLM and maintains competitive visual-description quality.
blocks.zh: 表2应理解为合同诊断,而不是领导板。 统一计划需要模型共同恢复局部元素,读取顺序,文字内容,以及视觉描述. 管道解析器往往保留了强大的OCR或本地化性能,但它们通常会留下标题链接和alt-text字段不完整. 通用的VLM可以产生更丰富的计划领域,但它们在空间地上不适应的可靠性更低. 文档专用VLM和SARA是互补的:前者在专业解析方面表现优异,而SARA则改进了被冻结的通用VLM的结构领域并保持有竞争力的可视化描述质量.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Main test-set results under the unified Read-Parse-Describe output schema. Rows are grouped by evaluation setting to separate Zero-shot Models , Full Fine-Tuning , which means fine-tuning the whole model, and Adapter Tuning , which means only fine-tuning the adapter part. -- indicates that the corresponding field is not produced by the evaluated system. bold and underlined scores denote the best and second-best results for each metric, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2:统一Read-Parse-Description输出方案下的主要测试集结果. 以评价设置来组合行,分别是"零射出"模型","Full Fine-Tuning"(指整个模型的微调)和"适配器图宁"(指仅指适配器部分的微调). --表示相应的字段不是被评价的系统产生的. 粗体和下划线的分数分别表示每个衡量标准的最佳和次最佳结果。

blocks.en: Table 2 reveals different strengths across the evaluated systems and reported metrics. Fine-tuned Dolphin-v2 achieves the strongest localization performance, reaching 0.9826 F1 and 0.9588 mIoU. It also obtains the highest RO score, 0.9857. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-OCR achieves the highest METEOR, 0.3998, while GPT-5.6 achieves the highest BERTScore, 0.9004. DeepSeek-OCR also maintains a high RO score of 0.9825. Among the evaluated proprietary zero-shot models, GPT-5.6 obtains the highest F1, RO, and description scores, while Gemini 3.6 Flash obtains the highest mIoU. Including Gemini 3.1 Pro extends the comparison to the requested Pro-series model under the same schema. These results suggest that spatially precise parsing and open-ended visual description remain partially distinct capabilities.
blocks.zh: 表2显示了所评价的系统和所报告衡量标准的不同优势。 Fine-tuned Dolphin-v2实现了最强的本地化性能,达到了0.9826 F1和0.9588 mIoU. 它也获得了最高的RO分,0.9857分. Fine-turned DeepSeek-OCR实现最高的METEOR,0.3998,而GPT-5.6实现最高的BERTSCore,0.9004. DeepSeek-OCR也保持了0.9825的高RO分. 在被评价的专有零发型中,GPT-5.6获得最高的F1,RO,并获得描述分数,而双子座 3.6 Flash获得最高的mIoU. 包括双子座 3.1 Pro 扩展了与请求的Pro系列型号在同一种计划下的比较. 这些结果表明,空间精确的剖析和开放式视觉描述仍然部分具有独特的能力。

blocks.en: Pipeline parsers remain competitive on some low-level fields but are less complete under the unified output schema. For example, MinerU reaches 0.9671 OCR accuracy and 0.9151 mIoU, but its RO score is 0.6757, and it does not produce visual alternative text under the evaluated schema. This does not mean that pipeline systems are ineffective. Instead, it identifies the fields that require additional modules or tighter integration when the target is a complete accessible page parse.
blocks.zh: 管道分解器在一些低等字段仍然具有竞争力,但在统一输出方案下则不完全. 例如,MinerU达到0.9671 OCR精度和0.9151 mIoU,但其RO分数为0.6757,在被评价的schema下不产生可视化替代文本. 这并不意味着管道系统无效。 相反,它确定了在目标是一个完全可访问的页面剖析时需要增加模块或更严格整合的字段.

blocks.en: Compared with the Qwen3.5-2B full fine-tuning baseline, SARA substantially improves structural performance while keeping the base VLM frozen and training with 83.99M parameters. F1 increases to 0.9189, mIoU to 0.8919, OCR accuracy to 0.9636, and RO score to 0.9774. Its alt-text scores, 0.3834 METEOR and 0.8946 BERTScore, are also competitive with the strongest fine-tuned document VLMs. On Gemma4-E4B, SARA also improves F1 and mIoU relative to full fine-tuning, but RO and both description metrics decrease slightly. Compared with LoRA-only adaptation, SARA improves F1 and mIoU by 0.2185 and 0.2074 on Qwen and 0.1750 and 0.1898 on Gemma, respectively. Other metrics show trade-offs: Qwen LoRA has higher OCR accuracy, while Gemma LoRA has higher RO and slightly higher BERTScore.
blocks.zh: 与Qwen3.5-2B全微调基线相比,SARA大幅度地改善了结构性能,同时保持了基础VLM被冷冻并用83.99M参数进行了训练. F1被提升到0.9189,mIoU被提升到0.8919,OCR精度被提升到0.9636,RO得分被提升到0.9774. 它的备选案文分数为0.3834METEOR和0.8946 BERTScore,也与最强的微调文件VLM相竞争. 在Gemma4-E4B上,SARA也比起全微调改进了F1和mIoU,但RO和两个描述度量度都略有下降. 相较于仅LORA的适应,SARA在Quen上分别改进了F1和mIoU0.2185和0.2074,在Gemma上则分别改进了0.1750和0.1898. 其他的度量衡显示取舍:Quen LoRA的OCR精度较高,而Gemma LoRA的RO精度较高而BERTScore也略高.

blocks.en: The main result is not that one model is uniformly best, but that single-axis strengths do not necessarily imply a coherent page parse. A model with high OCR but low RO may still fail to recover columns or reading sequences. A model with strong F1 but no alt-text may be useful as a front end, but it is incomplete as an accessible parser. Conversely, a model with strong alt-text but weak mIoU may describe objects that are poorly localized. Reporting these fields side by side makes such tradeoffs visible without imposing a deployment-specific ranking.
blocks.zh: 主要结果不是说一个模型是统一最好的,而是单轴优势并不一定意味着一个连贯的页面解析. 具有高OCR但低RO的模型仍然可能无法恢复列或读取序列. 具有强F1但无备选案文的模型可能作为前端有用,但作为可访问的剖面器不完整. 反之,一个具有强的备选案文而弱的mIoU的模型可以描述那些局部性差的物体. 同时报告这些战地使这种取舍变得显而易见,而没有强制规定具体部署的等级。

blocks.en: Table 4 isolates the contribution of each SARA component on Qwen3.5-2B. The full fine-tuning row is included as a reference, while all adapter rows keep the backbone frozen. Grid alignment alone provides a modest improvement over full fine-tuning, especially for RO and OCR. In contrast, projector-only training underperforms full fine-tuning, indicating that the gains do not come merely from adding trainable parameters. The full configuration, which combines grid-aware alignment with projector training, produces the largest improvement across all four structural metrics.
blocks.zh: 表4在Quen3.5-2B中分别列出SARA各组成部分的贡献。 完整的微调行被收录为参考,而所有适配行则保持主干线被冻结. 单是网格对接,就比全面微调略有改进,特别是对RO和OCR而言。 与此相反,只有投影员的培训表现不佳,表明收益不仅仅来自增加可训练参数。 将电网感知调和与投影器训练相结合的全配置,在所有四个结构度量中产生最大的改进.

blocks.en: Table 4 studies which visual feature layers are most useful for the adapter. Early-to-mid layers, {2,5,8,11}, outperform both shallow-only layers and late-layer selections. This pattern is consistent with the design goal of preserving local spatial cues while retaining sufficient semantic abstraction for document elements. On both tested backbones, SARA improves localization relative to full fine-tuning, while its effects on reading order and description similarity vary. Overall, these ablations suggest that SARA primarily acts as a spatial-structure adapter rather than as a general-purpose language-generation module. This also explains why alt-text improvements are more mixed than the localization and reading-order gains.
blocks.zh: 表4研究视觉特征层对适配器最有用. 早期到中层,{2,5,8,11},优于浅层和后层选择. 这种模式符合保护本地空间提示同时保留足够的文档元素语义抽象的设计目标. 在两个被测试的骨干上,SARA比起完全的微调改进了本地化,而其对读取顺序和描述相似性的影响则不同. 总的来说,这些拼接表明,SARA主要发挥空间结构适配器的作用,而不是通用语言生成模块的作用. 这也解释了为什么替代文本的改进比本地化和读取顺序增益更复杂.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Read-Parse-Describe, a unified benchmark for scientific-document parsing, and SARA, a spatial adapter tailored to the same page-level output contract. The task jointly evaluates localized elements, labels, reading order, textual and table content, caption links, and alternative text within a single ordered parse. Experiments show that existing systems tend to fail different parts in evaluation, while frozen-backbone SARA tuning substantially improves structural parsing for a general VLM.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Read-Parse-Description(科学文件解析的统一基准)和SARA(空间适配器),这是针对同一页级输出合同而设计的。 任务联合评价本地化元素,标签,读取顺序,文本和表格内容,标题链接,以及单个命令解析中的替代文本. 实验显示,现有系统在评价中往往会故障不同部分,而被冷冻后骨的SARA调取则会大大地改善一般VLM的结构剖析.

blocks.en: Limitations. Read-Parse-Describe is limited to open-access ACM scientific PDFs and primarily covers the first eight pages, leaving late appendices and references underrepresented. Alt-text annotations rely on LLM assistance with human refinement, and closed-source pre-training exposure cannot be fully excluded. The benchmark is intended to support accessible document understanding, search, and document mining, but generated accessibility metadata should not be treated as deployment-ready without further validation.
blocks.zh: 限制。 Read-Parse-Description仅限于开放存取的ACM科学PDF,主要覆盖前八页,留下后期附录和参考文献代表不足. 备选文字说明依赖于LLM对人修炼的帮助,封闭源代码培训前接触不能被完全排除. 该基准旨在支持无障碍文件理解、搜索和文件挖掘,但生成的可访问元数据在未经进一步验证的情况下,不应视为可部署。

blocks.en: Read-Parse-Describe uses a 23-label taxonomy rather than a small generic layout set. The goal is to keep elements that matter for reading order, reflow, caption linkage, and auditability visible as distinct targets. Headings, paragraph fragments, captions, equations, code blocks, metadata, references, lists, and visual objects therefore remain separately labeled.

blocks.en: A.2 Page Curation and Element Distributions
blocks.zh: A.2 页面校正和元素分配

blocks.en: The first-eight-page rule is intended to increase the density of multimodal scientific content while keeping each paper as a continuous page sequence. It preserves the early-paper regions where abstracts, methods, figures, tables, captions, equations, and author metadata interact most strongly. Later pages are not treated as unimportant; they are underrepresented because they are disproportionately reference-heavy in the analyzed full-text subset.
blocks.zh: 第一八页规则旨在增加多式科学内容的密度,同时将每张纸作为连续的页序. 它保留了摘要、方法、数字、表格、标题、方程式和作者元数据互动最强的早期文件区域。 后几页不被视为不重要;它们的代表性不足,因为它们在分析的全文子集中引用过多。

By comparing the element proportions in Pages 1–8 versus Pages ≥ 9 \geq 9 (estimated on a full-text subset), we observe that the truncation effectively preserves high-value multimodal objects while filtering out visually monotonous reference lists.

blocks.en: The following tables decompose the visual and layout population from two complementary angles. Subject categories describe the broad disciplinary context of visual instances. blocks.zh: 附录C 评价 度量衡

blocks.en: To quantitatively assess the performance of the fine-tuned models in handling complex scholarly layouts, we employ a multi-dimensional evaluation suite. This suite covers three complementary aspects: (1) physical localization of layout elements, (2) logical sequencing of the reading flow, and (3) textual and tabular accuracy of the extracted content.(4) Accessibility Metadata Evaluation .Such a decomposition is necessary because a model can, for example, detect elements correctly but still fail to order them properly, or produce fluent text while misplacing bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 为了从数量上评估微调模型在处理复杂的学术布局方面的表现,我们采用了多维评价套件。 该套装涵盖三个互补方面:(1)布局元素的物理局部化,(2)读取流的逻辑顺序,和(3)取取取内容的文字和表格精度. (4)无障碍元数据评价 . 这种分解是必要的,因为例如,一个模型可以正确检测元素,但仍然不能正确订购,或者在错误地放置捆绑框时产生流畅的文字.

blocks.en: 1. Physical Layout Analysis: F1-score and mIoU
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 物理布局分析:F1-分数和mIoU

blocks.en: For Document Layout Analysis (DLA), we evaluate the model’s ability to correctly identify and localize structural entities (e.g., figures, tables, and section blocks).
blocks.zh: 对于文档布局分析(DLA),我们评价模型正确识别和定位结构实体的能力(如数字、表格和区块)。

blocks.en: We compute the harmonic mean of Precision and Recall for each label category. A detection is considered a True Positive (TP) if (i) the predicted category matches the ground-truth category and (ii) the overlap between predicted and ground-truth regions exceeds a predefined threshold (typically based on IoU). The metric is defined as: F ​ 1 = 2 ⋅ P ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n ⋅ R ​ e ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ l P ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n + R ​ e ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ l F1=2\cdot\frac{Precision\cdot Recall}{Precision+Recall} In practice, F1-score summarizes the trade-off between missing elements (low Recall) and producing spurious detections (low Precision).

blocks.en: To measure geometric localization accuracy, we compute the Intersection over Union (IoU) between each predicted bounding box B p B_{p} and the corresponding ground-truth box B g ​ t B_{gt} . The mean IoU over N N matched instances is reported as: m ​ I ​ o ​ U = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N A ​ r ​ e ​ a ​ ( B p , i ∩ B g ​ t , i ) A ​ r ​ e ​ a ​ ( B p , i ∪ B g ​ t , i ) mIoU=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\frac{Area(B_{p,i}\cap B_{gt,i})}{Area(B_{p,i}\cup B_{gt,i})} Compared to F1-score, mIoU is more sensitive to precise boundary alignment, which is critical for downstream tasks such as figure-to-caption association or table cell reconstruction.

blocks.en: For general text extraction, we compute character-level edit distance between the recognized text and the reference transcription. This metric directly reflects transcription fidelity and is particularly informative for scientific documents containing symbols, subscripts, and uncommon terminology.

blocks.en: For table parsing, we use the Tree Edit Distance Based Similarity (TEDS), which evaluates both the global structure (row/column organization) and the cell content by representing tables as tree structures. The similarity is defined as: T ​ E ​ D ​ S ​ ( T a , T b ) = 1 − D ​ i ​ s ​ t t ​ r ​ e ​ e ​ ( T a , T b ) max ⁡ ( | T a | , | T b | ) TEDS(T_{a},T_{b})=1-\frac{Dist_{tree}(T_{a},T_{b})}{\max(|T_{a}|,|T_{b}|)} where T a T_{a} and T b T_{b} are the predicted and ground-truth table trees. This metric is more aligned with human judgment than plain text metrics, because it penalizes structural errors (e.g., merged/split cells) in addition to textual mistakes.

blocks.en: 4. Accessibility Metadata Evaluation: METEOR Score
blocks.zh: 4.四. 无障碍元数据 评价:METEOR分数

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality of the generated Alt-text for figures and tables, we employ the METEOR metric. While metrics like BLEU primarily focus on exact n-gram overlaps, METEOR is designed to capture the semantic nuances of scholarly descriptions more effectively.
blocks.zh: 为了评价生成的图和表格的Alt-text的质量,我们采用了METEOR指标。 虽然像BLEU这样的度量衡主要侧重于准确的正克重叠,但METEOR的设计是为了更有效地捕捉学术描述的语义细微差别.

blocks.en: In the context of academic document reconstruction, the description of a figure (Alt-text) can be linguistically diverse. METEOR is superior for this task due to its unique features:Synonym Matching: It utilizes a dictionary (like WordNet) to match synonyms. For instance, if the ground truth says "Diagram" and the model generates "Schematic," METEOR recognizes this as a valid match, whereas BLEU would penalize it.Stemming: It matches words with the same root (e.g., "clustering" and "clustered"), which is crucial for maintaining the technical accuracy of alt-text.Alignment-based Scoring: It creates an explicit alignment between the predicted string and the reference, penalizing incorrect word orders through a "fragmentation penalty."
blocks.zh: 在学术文献重建中,对一图(Alt-text)的描述在语言上可以多种多样. METEOR因其独特性而优于此任务: 同义词匹配 : 它利用词典(如WordNet)来匹配同义词. 例如,如果地面真理说"Diagram",而模型生成"Schematic",METEOR承认这是有效的匹配,而BLEU则会惩罚它. Stemming:它与同根(如"集群"和"被集群")相匹配的单词,这对于保持备选案文的技术准确性至关重要. 基于对齐的分数 : 它在预测的字符串和参考物之间建立了明确的对接,通过"分解处罚"来惩罚错误的单词命令.

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价详情

blocks.en: All reported systems are converted into the same element schema before scoring. Layout matching requires category agreement and an IoU threshold of 0.5. DLA-F1 is computed over matched layout elements, and mIoU averages the IoU of true-positive matches. Reading order is evaluated over matched element identifiers, so a model must both find the relevant element and place it correctly in the sequence. OCR is normalized before edit-distance scoring, and table content is scored through the serialized html field when a system produces it. Visual descriptions are scored only for visual instances with reference alternative text; a missing description for an applicable object receives zero for the description metric.
blocks.zh: 所有上报的系统在打分前被转换为同元素计划. 布局匹配需要类别协议和0.5的IoU阈值. DLA-F1的计算超过了匹配的布局元素,mIoU平均为真正匹配的IoU. 在匹配的元素标识符上评价读取顺序,因此一个模型既必须找到相关元素,也必须将其正确放在序列中. OCR在编辑-距离评分前实现常态化,当一个系统生成时,表格内容会被通过序列化的html字段打入. 视觉描述只被打入有参考可选文本的可视实例;一个适用对象的缺失描述会得到描述度量的零.

blocks.en: Unparsable predictions are not discarded globally. Minor syntax errors are repaired deterministically when the intended field structure is recoverable. If a prediction remains unparsable, only the affected fields are treated as empty. This localizes a syntax failure to the fields it prevents from being evaluated and avoids giving a model credit for content that cannot be reliably associated with an element object.
blocks.zh: 无法预测的预测不会在全球被抛弃。 当预期的字段结构可以恢复时,小的语法错误会得到决定性的修复. 如果一项预测仍无法解析,则只将受影响的区域视为空地。 这样可以将语法失败本地化到它无法被评价的字段,并避免给无法可靠地与元素对象关联的内容提供模型信用.

blocks.en: To better understand the limitations of SARA, we analyze two representative failure modes, shown in Figure 4 . First, borderless composite figures can confuse the model when multiple sub-figures and intra-image text are densely arranged. In such cases, visual and textual cues become entangled, which may shift predicted figure boxes away from their corresponding captions. Second, excessively dense tables can stress the decoding process. Although the table region may still be localized accurately, long serialized outputs may be truncated near the end, and the model may occasionally introduce minor irrelevant artifacts.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解SARA的局限性,我们分析两种有代表性的故障模式,见图4。 首先,当多个子图和图像内文本被密集排列时,无边界复合数字可以混淆模型. 在这种情况下,视觉和文字提示会缠绕在一起,这可能会使预测的数字框脱离相应的标题. 第二,过于密集的表格可以强调解码过程. 虽然表格区域仍可能精确地本地化,但长序式产出可能在接近尾端时被截取出,而模型偶尔也可能引入一些无关的小文物.
